resources.string: Development pilot, not the library cover picker. Downloaded images stay in private storage and never change this book\'s cover.

To find covers, ShelfOS sends this book\'s ISBN to Open Library. Open Library also sees your public IP address and that the request comes from ShelfOS (its User-Agent). Nothing from the book file, your notes, highlights, shelves or reading progress is sent. Previews and downloads are optional, stay in private device storage for this pilot, and do not change the library cover. This is separate from the online metadata setting.
